purpose: Canonical logical KV ownership, rank-local Host/device buffers and metadata-only snapshot assembly for ordinary dense TP/PP

interfaces.plan_capture_layout: Maps global logical heads and explicit contiguous PP stage ranges to canonical owners; keeps inactive ranks explicit and assigns aux to a chosen final-stage TP rank.
interfaces.HostBufferPool(partition=...): Allocates only locally owned KV geometry; aux and manifest capacity belong only to the aux owner. Rejects inactive ranks before registration.
interfaces.SelectedLayerKVExporter.from_pool(partit: Reads only owned local PP layers and validates rank-local head axes, without gathering KV tensors.
interfaces.prepare_snapshot_partition: Returns registered tensor views plus descriptors bound to common metadata after owner-local D2H completion.
interfaces.assemble_snapshot: Requires every expected owner once, identical metadata, canonical owner head ranges and consistent full logical coverage before constructing a manifest.

jobs.note: Full existing single-H100 serving regression because build_snapshot now shares the partition preparation and assembly implementation.

ownership_checks.reference: Actual QKVParallelLinear K weight loader with global head IDs encoded in source rows; observed local heads independently identify each head's first owner.
ownership_checks.cuda: TP4 canonical rank 2 exports one logical head per selected layer, with three-token staging and a five-token noncontiguous source path; immediate source-slot overwrite does not alter Host contents, including the partial tail.

store_observation.preparation: Fixture uses production layout, local Host pools, prepare_snapshot_partition and assemble_snapshot before independent owner writers start.

assertions: Only canonical head owners export replicated KV; all logical heads remain covered exactly once.
Inactive partitions cannot fall back to full-model allocation. Aux-only owners need no KV exporter or device staging.
Per-rank Host/device limits are checked before any buffer registration.
The local PP exporter never accesses another stage's selected layers.
Assembly rejects missing/duplicate owners, changed metadata and inconsistent valid-token counts.
Swapping owner head labels fails even when generic manifest validation sees complete logical coverage.
Ordinary single-owner snapshot construction uses the same preparation and assembly interfaces.
limits: Serving TP/PP/DP gates remain closed. Global identity binding from local models, synchronized admission/failure agreement, metadata transport, global teacher top-128/LSE and scheduler integration remain pending.
The topology planner assumes ordinary dense TP/PP with nonempty contiguous PP stage intervals. CP, sparse KV and quantized KV are not supported.
Source rank identity and the global KV contract must be established by the future coordinator. Local tensor shape alone cannot prove logical head identity.
Preparation does not extend buffer ownership. Callers retain local Host slots through D2H and Store completion and quarantine uncertain transfers.
Inactive ranks still need to participate in future collective/control ordering.
Unit and Store partition fixtures do not execute a distributed model forward; transport is local TCP, not RDMA. No production Catalog, consumer or SLO is certified.
Runtime regression uses one H100 and a synthetic KV-input draft. The optional cross-engine HF KV gate is not enabled; trained-model quality and TP/PP numerical parity remain unverified.

coverage: AR prefill/decode and raw teacher collection
Prefix hits, chunked prefill and one-token responses
All four static DSpark eager/graph and synchronous/overlap memory-pressure cases
Adaptive capture and scheduler latency protection
Real RadixCache eviction and explicit retract/resume
